headline: World leaders express concerns over US control of American AI, while Anthropic joins the Frontier carbon removal coalition and Odyssey achieves a $1.45B valuation
tldr: Today's AI news is dominated by concerns over the control and accessibility of American AI, with world leaders fearing the US could cut off access. Meanwhile, Anthropic has joined the Frontier carbon removal coalition, and Odyssey has achieved a significant valuation. Google is also betting on Gemini to reinvent the smart home speaker, and there are advancements in AI research, including language-guided 3D motion forecasting and the use of AI in open-source security.

new_models.title: Odyssey nabs $1.45B valuation
new_models.summary: World models are the next big thing in AI beyond LLMs, and with this round, Odyssey has cemented itself as one of the startups to watch.
new_models.why_it_matters: This significant valuation indicates the growing interest in world models and their potential to revolutionize the AI landscape.

new_models.title: Google bets on Gemini to reinvent the smart home speaker
new_models.summary: Google is betting generative AI can breathe new life into the smart speaker, replacing rigid commands with conversational Gemini interactions.
new_models.why_it_matters: This development showcases the potential of AI to transform traditional devices and create more intuitive user experiences.

research.title: MolmoMotion: Language-guided 3D motion forecasting
research.summary: This research introduces MolmoMotion, a language-guided 3D motion forecasting model.
research.why_it_matters: This research has the potential to advance the field of 3D motion forecasting and enable more sophisticated applications in areas like robotics and animation.

research.title: You Probably Don’t Need an Agent Framework
research.summary: Most LLM applications need a clear workflow, not an autonomous agent, and can be built using plain Python.
research.why_it_matters: This article highlights the importance of understanding the limitations and potential of agent frameworks in AI development.

features_updates.title: How to turn off AI in your Google Docs
features_updates.summary: This article provides instructions on how to disable AI features in Google Docs.
features_updates.why_it_matters: As AI becomes more integrated into everyday tools, users need to understand how to control and customize these features to suit their needs.

features_updates.title: VS Code 1.123 Adds Two-Hour Extension Update Delay
features_updates.summary: VS Code 1.123 introduces a two-hour delay before auto-updating extensions to limit supply chain attacks.
features_updates.why_it_matters: This update highlights the growing concern over supply chain attacks and the need for developers to prioritize security in their tools and workflows.

industry_business.title: Anthropic becomes first AI startup to join the Frontier carbon removal coalition
industry_business.summary: Anthropic has joined the Frontier coalition, which received $915M in pledges to fund carbon removal projects.
industry_business.why_it_matters: This partnership demonstrates the growing commitment of AI companies to address environmental concerns and invest in sustainable practices.

industry_business.title: NEA’s Tiffany Luck says enterprises are still figuring out their AI ROI
industry_business.summary: Enterprises are struggling to measure the return on investment of their AI initiatives, with some companies experiencing unexpected costs.
industry_business.why_it_matters: Understanding AI ROI is crucial for businesses to make informed decisions about their AI investments and strategies.

policy_society.title: World leaders want American AI, but don’t want America to be able to turn it off
policy_society.summary: World leaders are concerned about the potential for the US to cut off access to American AI, highlighting the need for international cooperation and agreements.
policy_society.why_it_matters: This issue underscores the complex geopolitical implications of AI development and the need for global dialogue on AI governance and regulation.

policy_society.title: Dangerous AI models are coming no matter what
policy_society.summary: AI models with advanced hacking capabilities will soon become the norm, posing significant security risks.
policy_society.why_it_matters: This prediction highlights the urgent need for researchers, policymakers, and industry leaders to develop and implement effective strategies for mitigating the risks associated with advanced AI models.
